description: This Java class implements the <map-to-map> element for the mini-language framework in the OFBiz project. It provides functionality to copy entries from one map to another within the method execution context, supporting XML configuration and validation.

classes.name: MapToMap
classes.description: Implements the <map-to-map> operation to copy data from one map to another in the environment.

classes.name: MapToMap.MapToMapFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MapToMap from XML elements.

methods.name: MapToMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the operation from an XML element and method context, performing validation and setting up map accessors.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the <map-to-map> operation, copying map entries from source to destination based on configuration.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MapToMap object, useful for debugging.
